verzen.tekst: He who lives forever created the whole universe.

verzen.tekst: The Lord alone is just.
verzen.html: The Lord alone is just.

voetnoten.tekst: The remainder of verse 2, and verse 3, are omitted by the best authorities.

verzen.tekst: He has given power to declare his works to no one.

verzen.tekst: Who could measure the strength of his majesty?
verzen.html: Who could measure the strength of his majesty?

verzen.tekst: As for the wondrous works of the Lord, it is not possible to take from them nor add to them,

verzen.tekst: When a man has finished, then he is just at the beginning.

verzen.tekst: What is mankind, and what purpose do they serve?

verzen.tekst: The number of man’s days at the most are a hundred years.

verzen.tekst: He has mercy on those who accept chastening,

verzen.tekst: My son, don’t add reproach to your good deeds,

verzen.tekst: Behold, isn’t a word better than a gift?

verzen.tekst: Learn before you speak.

verzen.tekst: Before judgement, examine yourself,

verzen.tekst: Humble yourself before you get sick.

verzen.tekst: Let nothing hinder you to pay your vow in due time.

verzen.tekst: A wise man is cautious in everything.

verzen.tekst: They who were of understanding in sayings also became wise themselves,

verzen.tekst: Don’t go after your lusts.
